MR Safety
The Ember Neurostimulation System is MR Conditional. A person with the Ember Neurostimulation System may be safely scanned under the following conditions. Failure to follow these conditions may result in injury.
Parameter Condition
Device Name Ember Neurostimulation System
Device Configuration MRI mode ON
Static Magnetic Field Strength (B0) 1.5 Tesla and 3.0 Tesla only
Maximum Spatial Field Gradient 12 T/m
Maximum Gradient Slew Rate 200 T/m/s per axis
RF Receive Coil Type Any
Operating Mode Normal Operating Mode
RF Conditions Whole-Body SAR ≤ 1 W/kg
Scan Regions Exclusion zone: do not position the isocenter between the C7 vertebra and the iliac crest
Image Artifact The image artifact extends approximately 40 mm from the device.
Scanning at 7 T has not been evaluated; do not scan at field strengths other than those listed.
